cs.t: I have two monitors. A 27" Apple Cinema display from 2012 that I got used in 2015, and an LG Ultra HD (4K) that I picked up last year new. Yes, the LG is newer, 4K, has a higher DPI, etc.  But I often find myself putting my most important windows on the Apple Display.  The color is just so much more beautiful and vibrant, the clarity and contrast are superior, it's just so much better. Sure, I can't fit as much code on it as the LG, but boy is it pretty.  Apple definitely puts quality in their monitors.  It's a shame they left the consumer market in 2016.
